name: Retry Pattern
description: Transparently retries a failed operation to absorb transient faults.

name: Exponential Backoff
description: Increases delay between retry attempts exponentially to reduce contention.

name: Circuit Breaker Pattern
description: Stops calling a failing dependency until it recovers, preventing cascading failures.

name: Best-Effort Delivery
description: Delivers messages without guaranteeing receipt, trading reliability for speed.

name: Static Content Hosting
description: Serves static assets (images, fonts, scripts) directly from storage or a CDN.

name: Compensating Transaction
description: Undoes the effects of a prior step in a multi-step operation that later fails.

name: Bulkhead Pattern
description: Isolates resources into pools so one failure can't exhaust the whole system.

name: Observability Pattern
description: Emits logs, metrics, and traces so system behavior can be inspected after the fact.

name: Asynchronous Request-Reply
description: Returns a token immediately and lets the client poll or get notified when work completes.

name: Queue-Based Load Leveling
description: Buffers requests in a queue so consumers process at a sustainable rate.

name: Pipes and Filters Pattern
description: Decomposes processing into a sequence of reusable, composable filter stages.

name: Self-Healing Pattern
description: Automatically detects and recovers from failure without manual intervention.

name: Compute Resource Consolidation
description: Groups multiple tasks onto shared compute resources to reduce cost and overhead.

name: Cache-Aside Pattern
description: Loads data into cache on demand and reads from cache before hitting the source.

name: Sharding Pattern
description: Splits a dataset into partitions (shards) by key range to scale storage and throughput.

name: Backup Pattern
description: Periodically snapshots data so it can be restored after loss or corruption.

name: Streaming Pattern
description: Processes data continuously as it arrives rather than in discrete batches.

name: Lazy Loading Pattern
description: Defers expensive computation or data loading until the value is actually needed.

name: Throttling Pattern
description: Limits the rate of requests a service accepts to protect it from overload.

name: Health Endpoint Monitoring
description: Exposes a dedicated endpoint that reports service health to external monitors.

name: Correlation ID Pattern
description: Attaches a shared identifier to a request as it flows across services, for tracing.

name: Multiversion Concurrency Control
description: Lets reads and writes proceed concurrently by keeping multiple versions of data.

name: Distributed Lock Pattern
description: Coordinates exclusive access to a shared resource across multiple nodes.

name: Idempotence Pattern
description: Ensures repeating the same operation produces the same result as doing it once.
